messages.subject: hierarchical Dirichlet processes
parts:
Hi all,

I am learning how to implement Dirichlet process mixture models in nimble using both the Chinese Restaurant Process and the stick-breaking representation.

I noticed at the bottom of the tutorial here, there is mention of future development in nimble of new advances in Bayesian non-parametrics, including hierarchical Dirichlet processes (HDPs).

I was wondering if there is any new development with respect to HDPs being implemented in nimble. If not, is there a way to program a HDP in the current version of nimble?

Thanks in advance!
Jake

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: hierarchical Dirichlet processes
parts:
Hi Jacob,

We had some work planned to implement the HDP, but that never reached fruition. It should be possible to program in nimble, perhaps building on ideas
from our existing CRP sampler (see the file "BNP_samplers.R"). I'll note that much of the complication in the existing CRP sampler is in the setup code
for the sampler, which does a lot of checking to make sure the sampler is valid for the model structure given by a user. If you were coding it for your own
use you could presumably skip that complication.

I'm checking with some colleagues who did much of the work on the CRP sampler to see if they have any useful information to share on HDP.

-chris
